hints.content: A prime number has exactly two factors: $1$ and itself.

The factors of $27$ are $1, 3, 9,$ and $27.$

$27$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $55$ are $1, 5, 11,$ and $55.$

$55$ has $4$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $59$ are $1$ and $59.$

$59$ has **exactly** two factors so it is a prime number.

The factors of $63$ are $1, 3, 7, 9, 21,$ and $63.$

$63$ has $6$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.

The factors of $72$ are $1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 9, 12, 18, 24, 36,$ and $72$.

$72$ has $12$ factors so it is **not** a prime number.
